scientific_integrity.computations: Exact standalone verifier for path profiles and Walsh spectra \(n\le12\) and nonnegative transfer identities through \(n\le60\) (18430 assertions).
scientific_integrity.limitations: Does not cover individual up/down indicators, height-restricted excursions, local-height weights or other Fourier groups. Numerical checks alone are not the infinite proof.
scientific_integrity.priority_risk: An unindexed position-weighted Motzkin identity might imply the Fourier characterization. No external independent validation has been performed.
scientific_integrity.proof_basis: Nonnegative factorization of commuting height-transfer operators and parity-conjugation symmetry; direct small-boundary treatment.
scientific_integrity.theorem_scope: Counting push-forward of ordinary length-n Motzkin excursions to their horizontal-step position masks, over the Boolean group, for every integer \(n\ge0\); unnormalized Walsh transform.

title: Riordan spectral gaps and full Walsh recovery from Motzkin horizontal-step profiles
